layout.title: AegisCart - Agentic Commerce Control Console
layout.description: Policy-first agentic commerce gateway for Razorpay test mode

hero.description: AegisCart provides the deterministic trust layer for profitable agent-to-agent commerce. Every money decision is handled by policy, not AI—enabling safe, explainable transactions between autonomous buyers and merchants.

process.title: AI Handles Conversation
process.description: Natural language processing understands customer intent and negotiates terms—but ONLY for discussion, never for money decisions.

process.title: Policy Engine Enforces Rules
process.description: Deterministic controls enforce discount caps, minimum margins, quantity limits and approval thresholds.

process.title: Human Approval When Needed
process.description: Risky transactions are held for explicit review—no automatic overrides. High-value orders require merchant consent.

values.title: Increase Revenue Safely
values.description: Enable AI-driven sales conversations while protecting your margins with automated policy enforcement.

values.title: Eliminate Fraud & Abuse
values.description: Cryptographically signed offers prevent tampering and replay attacks. Every transaction is traceable and verifiable.

values.title: Meet Compliance Requirements
values.description: Automated audit trails with explainable decisions satisfy regulatory requirements for AI governance and financial controls.

values.title: Human-in-the-Loop Control
values.description: Configurable approval workflows ensure high-risk transactions get human review before funds are transferred.

items.title: Mathematical Precision
items.description: Policy, pricing, signatures and idempotency are pure mathematical functions. Zero AI involvement in money decisions.

items.title: Cryptographic Security
items.description: HMAC-SHA256 signed offers and mandates prevent tampering, replay attacks and unauthorized modifications.

items.title: Complete Visibility
items.description: An append-only ledger with a live event stream provides real-time auditability of every transaction and decision.

items.title: Explainable AI
items.description: The LLM only touches language. It never decides a number that touches money; every action has a traceable reason code.

cta.title: See a Protected Transaction in Action
cta.description: Open the console to follow a buyer request from conversation to policy check, signed offer, payment, and audit record.

company.name: AegisCart
company.description: Built for the Razorpay Buildathon · Track 01 — AI Growth & Agentic Commerce
